_meta.description: FIFA World Cup 2026 venues. FIFA mandates sponsor-free tournament names. All 16 venues had natural/hybrid grass (synthetic-fiber reinforced) installed per FIFA requirement.
_meta.capacity_note: Approximate World Cup configurations as reported by FIFA/host sources.

venues.fifa_name: Estadio Ciudad de Mexico (Mexico City Stadium)
venues.stadium_name: Estadio Azteca (renamed Estadio Banorte for sponsorship in 2025)
venues.transit: Metro Line 2 to Tasquena, then Tren Ligero light rail to Estadio Azteca station. From airport: Metro Line 5 -> Pantitlan -> Line 9 -> Chabacano -> Line 2; ~90 min, ~25 pesos.
venues.quirks: Altitude ~7,200 ft (2,200 m). First stadium to host three WC opening matches (1970, 1986, 2026); hosted 1970 and 1986 finals. Renovated; expected near 90,000 for the tournament.

venues.transit: No direct rail. Mi Macro Periferico BRT to 'Estadio Chivas' station + 15-20 min walk. Mi Tren Line 3 reaches Zapopan (BRT connection at Periferico Belenes). FIFA 'Ride al Estadio' shuttles from 10 pickup points (advance reservation; ~15 min walk from drop-off). Unified fare 11 pesos; Mi Movilidad card (30 pesos) required, many stations cashless.
venues.quirks: Home of Chivas; some sources list 49,000 capacity.

venues.transit: Metrorrey Line 1 to Exposicion station, ~10 min walk. Buses 214, 223, TME, 093 also serve the venue.
venues.quirks: Among the four highest heat-risk host cities; June-July highs low-to-mid 90s F, rare 110s.

venues.transit: No rail in Arlington. Official route: Trinity Railway Express from Victory Station (Dallas) or Central Station (Fort Worth) to CentrePort, then free matchday shuttle (match ticket required) + ~0.5 mile walk.
venues.quirks: Largest WC26 venue. Retractable roof + air conditioning. Hosts a semifinal (July 14).

venues.transit: NJ Transit via Secaucus Junction, then matchday-only train/bus (ticket holders only). Round trip $105, capped at 40,000/match, pre-purchase on NJ Transit app; physical wristband required for return. Penn Station NY <-> Secaucus restricted to WC ticket holders from 4 hours pre-kickoff.
venues.quirks: Hosts the FINAL, July 19, 2026, 3:00 PM EDT. Open-air, no AC.

venues.transit: MARTA rail, two adjacent stations (Vine City / GWCC side). Standard fares kept for WC; ~$5 round trip.
venues.quirks: Retractable roof + air conditioning. Hosts a semifinal (July 15).

venues.transit: No rail. RideKC buses get near the stadium but service is limited with a walk remaining - the most car/shuttle-dependent US venue.
venues.quirks: Open-air; hot and humid (upper 80s-90 F). Hosts a quarterfinal (July 11).

venues.transit: METRORail Red Line direct from downtown to NRG Park (Stadium Park/Astrodome station).
venues.quirks: Retractable roof + air conditioning - heat a concern outside, not during matches. Houston has the most dangerous June-July heat+humidity of all host cities.

venues.transit: VTA light rail stop directly at the stadium. From SF: Caltrain + VTA; from East Bay: BART + VTA.
LA Metro C or K Line light rail + short SoFi Shuttle bus ride.
venues.quirks: Fixed translucent canopy with open sides (no AC). Hosts a quarterfinal (July 10). USA opens here June 12.

venues.transit: SEPTA Broad Street Line to NRG Station at the sports complex; $2.90 fare and FREE rides leaving after WC matches.
venues.quirks: Open-air; Philly averages ~26 days of 90 F+ across June-July.

venues.transit: Sound Transit Link 1 Line (Stadium / International District stations). ORCA 3-Day World Cup Pass: $18 unlimited regional rides.

No nearby rail. Brightline to Aventura + Hard Rock Stadium Connect shuttle (departs ~10 min after train); Game Day Express shuttles link Metrorail, Metrobus, Tri-Rail, Brightline; or Metrorail to Golden Glades / Dr. MLK Jr. + Metrobus Route 297.
venues.quirks: ~15 mi north of downtown Miami. Open-air canopy. Hosts a quarterfinal (July 11) and third-place match (July 18). Avg heat index ~102 F mid-June to mid-July.

venues.transit: 14 express 'Boston Stadium Trains' per match between South Station and Foxboro Station (no intermediate stops). Round trip $80 via MBTA mTicket.
venues.quirks: ~28 mi from Boston. Open-air. Hosts a quarterfinal (July 9).

venues.transit: SkyTrain via Expo Line (Stadium-Chinatown) or Canada Line (Yaletown-Roundhouse).
venues.quirks: Retractable roof but effectively open-air, no AC. Alcohol-free seating sections offered. Mildest host-city weather.

venues.transit: GO Transit Exhibition Station adjacent; TTC streetcars to Exhibition Place; UP Express + TTC from Pearson Airport.
venues.quirks: Smallest WC26 venue (expanded for tournament). Canada opens here June 12 vs Bosnia and Herzegovina.
